verdict.rationale: Okta's own docs show SCIM-based user provisioning integrations: it pushes user and group CRUD to connected apps, which covers the downstream app-assignment half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows an HRIS acting as the authoritative source feeding Okta, or automated joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle handling. Missing for 10: HRIS-as-source-of-truth (inbound HR import) evidence, documented joiner/mover/leaver automation into the directory and app assignments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, HR drives identity — the HRIS is the source of truth, and joiner/mover/leaver changes flow into the directory and app assignments automatically

citations.quote: This guide series teaches you how to build an Okta integration that uses the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) protocol to handle user provisioning.
SCIM provides a defined schema for representing users and groups, and a RESTful API to run CRUD operations on those user and group resources.
